description: Third prize awarded in the IEEE Smart Village (ISV) student project competition.

title: IEEE IAS CMD Outstanding Member Award
name: Hamza Gharsellaoui
description: This award honors Hamza Gharsellaoui for his exceptional leadership as coordinator of ENIF 5.0 and his significant technical achievements. He played a key role in developing the prototype that enabled IEEE IAS ENIS to secure First Place in the IEEE IAS CMD Humanitarian Award Contest 2024, while also contributing to the team’s success in winning First Place in the IAS Technical Challenge at TSYP 12. His dedication reflects both organizational excellence and innovative impact within the IEEE IAS community.

title: IEEE IAS CMD Chapter Outstanding Large IAS Chapter Award
name: IEEE IAS ENIS SBC
description: The IEEE IAS ENIS Student Branch Chapter received the Outstanding Large IAS Chapter Award from IEEE IAS CMD, recognizing its impactful activities such as ENIF 4.0, Blockchain Bootcamp, Video Editing Workshop, and other technical and professional initiatives. This award reflects the chapter’s leadership, innovation, and strong commitment to member engagement.

title: IEEE IAS CMD Outstanding Member Award
name: Amir Abid
description: Amir Abid has been honored with the IEEE IAS CMD Outstanding Member Award 2024 for his exceptional dedication and leadership. He played a pivotal role as coordinator in organizing ENIF 4.0, actively led the Blockchain Bootcamp and ENIF Bootcamp, and contributed to numerous other chapter activities. His commitment to professional growth and IEEE engagement was further demonstrated by his participation in the 59th IAS Annual Meeting, showcasing his initiative and impact within the IAS community.

title: IEEE IAS CMD Chapter Best Website Award
name: IEEE IAS ENIS SBC
description: The IEEE IAS ENIS Student Branch Chapter has been honored with the CMD Chapter Best Website Award by the IEEE Industry Applications Society’s Chapter and Membership Development (CMD) department. This award recognizes the chapter’s excellence in creating a professional, engaging, and informative online presence, showcasing its activities, achievements, and commitment to member engagement. The award reflects IAS ENIS’s dedication to communication, innovation, and accessibility in connecting with the IEEE community.

title: IEEE IAS CMD Humanitarian Award contest
name: IEEE IAS ENIS SBC
description: IEEE IAS ENIS SBC is proud to receive the CMD Humanitarian Award for BuddyBot, an eco-friendly, AI-powered robot. It supports autistic children in learning, communication, and social interaction. By combining innovation with sustainability, BuddyBot creates an inclusive and engaging environment. This award highlights our chapter’s commitment to using technology for humanitarian impact.

title: 1st Place in the Non-Technical Challenge at IEEE IAS Tunisia Annual Meeting
name: IEEE IAS ENIS SBC
description: Awarded 1st Place in the Non-Technical Challenge at the IEEE IAS Tunisia Annual Meeting, recognizing our team’s creativity, strategic thinking, and impactful contribution beyond the technical field.

title: Best IAS Tunisia Student Branch Chapter
name: IEEE IAS ENIS SBC
description: We are thrilled to announce that IEEE IAS ENIS SBC has been awarded the title of Best IAS Tunisia! This milestone reflects our commitment, teamwork, and relentless pursuit of excellence in industrial applications.
